library.description: Native filesystem and S3 object storage backend

blocks.text: 用同一套 `blob` API 将附件、导出文件等二进制内容保存到专用目录或 S3，并按需读取完整字节、流或指定范围。选择文件或 S3 驱动，再把 object 插件安装到 host，即可使用组织隔离与读取资源释放；条件写入须由所选驱动和服务实际支持，本包不提供普通键值存储或事务。
English · 使用指南

本地驱动把内容与元数据一起发布；已打开的读取仍看到原内容。本地文件

S3 驱动区分写入失败、提交未知和写后元数据失败，便于决定如何恢复。S3
组织视图隔离逻辑键，分页游标绑定组织与前缀。组织与分页

blocks.code:
import { writeFile, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

await writeFile('./example.bin', new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3])) // 写入途中可能被其它请求读取。

console.log(await readFile('./example.bin')) // 全量读入；没有范围或 etag 条件。

blocks.text: 这些 storage 包当前是 `private: true` 的仓库 workspace 包，尚不作为已发布的 registry 包提供。在仓库内消费包添加：
SDK 是包声明的真实 peer。本地 `/fs` 入口按 Node、Bun、Deno 选择原生文件适配；S3 使用独立 `/s3` 入口，签名使用 `/features/presign`。根插件工厂不会打开目录或创建客户端，资源在安装时打开。包声明 Node.js `>=24`。

rows: 安装后端，默认 ID 为 `object`
写内容、开读取对象、只读元数据
删除或分页枚举本组织对象
明确选择 S3 签名 API

items: 后端提供 blob，不提供普通 KV 或事务。逻辑键是字符串，空字符串也合法。metadata 值为字符串；S3 另要求名称为小写 HTTP token、值为无换行的 ASCII 头字节。
一个真实目录只支持本进程内一个写实例；跨进程共享不受支持。目录必须可信且专用，不要放其它应用文件。文件更新提供原子可见性，不保证 fsync 级掉电耐久。文件 etag 基于内容 SHA-256，同字节内容可能保留同一 etag，不能把它当每次更新递增的版本号。
`get/head` 缺失返回 `undefined`；`remove` 返回删除前是否观察到对象。`get` 的 `stream/bytes` 共享一次消费机会；EOF 或 cancel 释放底层读取，未消费或提前结束应显式 dispose。
range 的 `start`、`end` 是非负安全整数，end 为闭区间；省略 end 读到末尾。`info.size` 始终是完整大小。范围起点超过内容时返回空内容，不把对象当作缺失。
`ifMatch` 与 `ifNoneMatch: true` 互斥，条件失败报 `WRITE_CONFLICT`。S3 条件能力由检测确认；不支持时条件写报 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`，不会退回无条件写。
对象错误 source 为 `storage.backend.object`。`OBJECT_DATA_INVALID` 表示数据或响应不完整；`OBJECT_COMMIT_UNKNOWN` 表示提交确认未知；`OBJECT_FAILED` 可能带 `committed: true`，表示写入已确认而后续元数据读取失败。先检查状态再决定重试。
`host.org(uuid).backend('object').use(blob)` 隔离组织；关闭宿主释放读资源和自建 S3 客户端。调用方传入的 `S3Client` 始终借用，需调用方自己关闭。

blocks.text: English · 概览与安装

rows: 保存本地内容并检查覆盖条件
不把整个大文件读入内存
让客户端直接上传或下载

blocks.text: `root` 是非空目录路径，目录由插件专用。下面先写入并读取，再只在 etag 仍匹配时覆盖。
`ifNoneMatch: true` 只在不存在时创建；`ifMatch: etag` 只在当前标识相同才写，两者互斥。失败报 contract `WRITE_CONFLICT`，不覆盖现有内容。etag 应原样传回；文件 etag 由内容哈希生成，同字节内容的再次写入可能不改变它，因此不能检测仅 metadata 的每次变动。
本地驱动支持 Node、Bun、Deno，安装时选择对应文件适配。一个真实目录只允许本进程一个写实例，不能由多个进程共同写。插件可能清理自己的未完成文件，因此目录要可信且专用。内容与 metadata 通过一次指针替换同时可见，已打开读对象不受后续覆盖或删除影响；此保证不包含掉电耐久或跨进程锁。
上传接受 `Uint8Array` 或未锁定的 `ReadableStream<Uint8Array>`。流块必须是字节数组。下面从流上传四个字节，再读取闭区间 `[1, 2]`。
`end` 省略时读到末尾，超出末尾会截短；`start` 超出大小或对象本身为空时返回空流。`info.size` 仍表示完整对象。需要持续消费时，使用 `object.stream().pipeTo(destination)`；不要再调用 `bytes()`。两种方式共享一次消费机会，第二次消费会拒绝。`bytes()` 会聚合所选内容，适合大小可控的读取。
EOF、流错误与 cancel 会释放底层读取。尚未消费、提前停止或异常退出时，仍用 `finally` 释放对象，或 `await using`。对象不能交给多个独立消费者。取消与超时通过 `options.ctx` 提供；上传的流也需要配合取消，不要无限阻塞生产者。
先创建桶并配置 SDK 能使用的凭据。下面假定 `application-objects` 桶位于 `us-east-1`，使用 SDK 默认凭据链，不把密钥写入代码。
兼容服务可在 `config` 配置 `endpoint` 与 `forcePathStyle`。`client` 与 `config` 必须二选一：传入 `client` 是借用，宿主不 destroy；传入 `config` 则安装时创建客户端，关闭时销毁。`prefix` 默认 `''`；逻辑键还会按组织编码，所以不要假定它与桶中裸对象名相同。
未知长度的流及达到阈值的字节数组使用 multipart。默认同时缓冲的上界为五段加输入当前块。上传失败会尝试清理未完成 multipart；清理失败经宿主 report 报告。修改请求局部禁用 SDK 重试与区域重定向，不改调用方 client 的全局配置，避免自动重放结果不明的提交。
默认环境检测先 `HeadBucket`，失败会阻止创建。随后会在保留前缀下写入并删除随机探测对象，验证条件写；缺少相关权限或条件不支持会报告，条件能力保持不可用，而不把无条件操作伪装成条件成功。实际无条件操作仍受服务权限限制。条件 multipart 还必须由服务支持最终 Complete 请求的条件；不支持时拒绝，不回退。
S3 metadata 名称须为小写 HTTP token，值须为无换行 ASCII；contentType 也需合法头值。etag 不透明；updatedAt 使用原生 LastModified。读取范围时，会核对服务的 Content-Range 和内容长度；损坏或不完整响应是错误，不能作为缺失处理。
签名只支持 S3，必须明确选择 `objectPresignFeature()`。下面生成一个带内容类型约束的上传请求；签名本身不上传内容。
把返回的 `url`、`method` 与全部 `headers` 交给实际 HTTP 客户端。漏掉内容、metadata、条件或 range 头会改变已签名请求。`expiresInSeconds` 为 `1` 到 `604800` 的整数秒，默认 `900`；实际有效期不会超过凭据有效期。上传支持与 `put` 相同的条件，下载支持闭区间 range。不要把临时签名 URL 写进公开日志。
下面在新组织内存两项，再沿返回游标翻页；不要自己构造或跨组织复用游标。
`list` 默认 prefix 为 `''`、limit 为 `100`；limit 必须为正安全整数。键按 UTF-16 字典序排列，游标绑定同一安装实例、组织与前缀。分页不承诺跨页快照，翻页期间的并发写入可能改变后续结果。`removeByPrefix('')` 只清当前组织，并返回实际观察到的删除数；它不是跨对象事务。

blocks.text: 对象错误 source 是 `storage.backend.object`，共享校验与条件错误来自 `storage.contract`。保留 cause 供诊断。显式关闭失败会拒绝；资源语法会报告清理失败，避免覆盖主错误。先释放读取对象，再关闭宿主；调用方注入的 S3Client 仍需自己关闭。关闭不删除已保存内容。

Save attachments, exports and other binary content in a dedicated directory or S3 through the same `blob` API, then read complete bytes, a stream or a selected range. Choose a file or S3 driver and install the object plugin in a host to use organization isolation and disposable reads. Conditional writes require support from the selected driver and service; this module does not provide ordinary key-value storage or transactions.
中文 · Usage guide

items: Readers see a new data file before its metadata is updated because two writes become visible separately.
Two requests overwrite a file from the same old version because checking and writing are unprotected.
Reading a small section loads the entire file because the API has no range support.
An interrupted download leaves a handle open because stream consumption and cleanup are separate.
The filesystem driver publishes content and metadata together; an open read keeps its original content. Local files
`get()` returns a disposable object with a choice of `bytes()` or `stream()` and inclusive byte ranges. Streams and ranges
S3 distinguishes failed writes, unknown commits and failures reading metadata after a write, helping recovery decisions. S3
Organization views separate logical keys, and page cursors are tied to organization and prefix. Organizations and pages

blocks.text: Use a directory dedicated to this plugin. This example writes `hello` and reads it from the actual filesystem.
Expected output:
Direct file writes save bytes, but metadata and concurrent updates need additional coordination:

blocks.code:
import { writeFile, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

await writeFile('./example.bin', new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3])) // Other requests may read mid-write.
await writeFile('./example.meta', JSON.stringify({ size: 3 })) // Published separately from content.
console.log(await readFile('./example.bin')) // Full read; no range or etag condition.

blocks.text: These storage module are currently `private: true` workspace module in this repository, not published registry module. Add them from a consuming module inside the workspace:

The SDK module are declared native peers. `/fs` selects a Node, Bun or Deno file adapter. Use `/s3` for S3 and `/features/presign` for signing. The root plugin factory does not open directories or construct clients; installation opens resources. The module declares Node.js `>=24`.

rows: Write content, open a read, or inspect metadata
Consume content once and release it
Delete or page through this organization's objects

items: This backend provides blob, not ordinary KV or transactions. Logical keys are strings, including the empty string. Metadata values are strings; S3 additionally requires lowercase HTTP-token names and ASCII header values without line breaks.

A real directory supports one writer instance in the current process. Sharing it across processes is unsupported. Keep it trusted and dedicated, without unrelated application files. Filesystem updates provide atomic visibility, not fsync-level power-loss durability. File etags are SHA-256 content hashes: the same bytes may retain an etag, so it is not an incrementing update version.

Missing `get/head` returns `undefined`. `remove` reports whether it observed an object before deleting. `stream/bytes` share one consumption right. EOF or cancellation releases the read; explicitly dispose unread or abandoned objects.
Range `start/end` are nonnegative safe integers; end is inclusive and optional. `info.size` remains the full size. A start beyond the content returns empty bytes, not an absent object.

`ifMatch` and `ifNoneMatch: true` are mutually exclusive. Failed conditions use `WRITE_CONFLICT`. S3 conditions require detection support and reject with `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` when unavailable, without falling back to unconditional writes.

Object errors use `source: 'storage.backend.object'`. `OBJECT_DATA_INVALID` means corrupt data or incomplete responses; `OBJECT_COMMIT_UNKNOWN` means commit confirmation is unknown. `OBJECT_FAILED` may include `committed: true` when writing succeeded but follow-up metadata reading failed. Inspect state before retrying.

`host.org(uuid).backend('object').use(blob)` separates organizations. Host shutdown releases read resources and S3 clients created from config. A caller-supplied `S3Client` is always borrowed and must be closed by its caller.

blocks.text: 中文 · Overview and installation

rows: Save local content and protect overwrites
Avoid reading a whole large file into memory
Use a remote bucket and multipart uploads
Let a client upload or download directly
Separate organization files and page through keys
Decide whether a failed write can be retried

blocks.text: `root` is a nonempty path to a dedicated directory. This example writes and reads content, then overwrites only while its etag still matches.

`ifNoneMatch: true` creates only if absent; `ifMatch: etag` writes only when the current identifier matches. They are mutually exclusive. A failed condition uses contract `WRITE_CONFLICT` without overwriting existing content. Pass the etag back unchanged. Filesystem etags are content hashes, so writing the same bytes may leave the etag unchanged; it cannot detect every metadata-only update.

The filesystem driver supports Node, Bun and Deno, selecting an adapter during installation. A real directory allows one writer in this process and cannot be shared by writing processes. Keep it trusted and dedicated because the plugin may reclaim its unfinished files. A single pointer replacement publishes bytes and metadata together; open read objects retain their content after overwrite or deletion. This does not provide power-loss durability or cross-process locking.
Uploads accept `Uint8Array` or an unlocked `ReadableStream<Uint8Array>`; chunks must be byte arrays. Upload four bytes from a stream, then read inclusive range `[1, 2]`:

Omit `end` to read through EOF; ends beyond EOF are clipped. A start beyond the size or an empty object returns an empty stream. `info.size` still describes the full object. For continuous consumption use `object.stream().pipeTo(destination)`, then do not call `bytes()`. Both share one consumption right; consuming again rejects. `bytes()` collects the selected content and suits reads with bounded size.

EOF, stream errors and cancellation release the native read. Use `finally` or `await using` for unread objects, early exits and failures. Do not give one object to multiple independent consumers. Provide cancellation and timeout through `options.ctx`; stream producers must cooperate with cancellation rather than block indefinitely.

Create a bucket and configure credentials the SDK can resolve. This example assumes an `application-objects` bucket in `us-east-1` and uses the SDK's default credential chain rather than hard-coded secrets.

For compatible services, set `endpoint` and `forcePathStyle` in `config`. Choose exactly one of `client` and `config`. A supplied client is borrowed and never destroyed by the host; config creates a client during installation and destroys it during shutdown. `prefix` defaults to `''`. Logical keys are also encoded for organizations, so do not assume they equal raw bucket object names.

rows: `8388608` (8 MiB), safe integer at least `5242880` (5 MiB)

blocks.text: Unknown-length streams and byte arrays at or above the threshold use multipart. Default buffering is bounded by five parts plus the current input chunk. Failed uploads attempt to clean up incomplete multipart state; cleanup failures reach the host report callback. Mutation requests locally disable SDK retries and region redirects without changing the supplied client's global settings, avoiding automatic replay of uncertain commits.

Default environment detection starts with `HeadBucket`; failure prevents host creation. It then writes and deletes random probe objects under a reserved prefix to check conditions. Missing probe permissions or unsupported conditions are reported and leave conditional writes unavailable, rather than treating unconditional writes as conditional success. Actual unconditional operations still require service permissions. Conditional multipart also requires conditions on the final Complete request; unsupported services reject without fallback.

S3 metadata names must be lowercase HTTP tokens, and values must be ASCII without line breaks. Content type must also be a valid header value. Etags are opaque; updatedAt comes from native LastModified. Range reads verify Content-Range and length; incomplete responses are failures, not missing objects.
Signing is S3-only and requires explicit `objectPresignFeature()` selection. Generate an upload request constrained by content type; signing itself does not upload data.

Give the actual HTTP client the returned `url`, `method` and every header. Omitting content, metadata, condition or range headers changes the signed request. `expiresInSeconds` accepts integer seconds from `1` to `604800`, defaulting to `900`. Actual validity cannot exceed credential expiry. Uploads support the same conditions as `put`; downloads support inclusive ranges. Keep temporary signed URLs out of public logs.
Write two objects inside a new organization, then page with the returned cursor. Do not construct cursors or reuse them across organizations.

`list` defaults to prefix `''` and limit `100`. Limit must be a positive safe integer. Keys use UTF-16 lexical order; cursors bind to one installation, organization and prefix. Paging is not a snapshot across pages: concurrent writes can change later results. `removeByPrefix('')` clears only this organization and counts observed removals; it is not a cross-object transaction.

rows: Correct keys, bodies, ranges, conditions or headers
Etag condition failed; reread and decide how to merge
The driver, condition or Feature does not support this combination
Stored data or a service response is incomplete; do not treat it as absent
Commit was sent but confirmation is unknown; inspect head/content before replaying
Inspect cause; `committed: true` means the write succeeded and metadata follow-up failed

blocks.text: Object errors use `source: 'storage.backend.object'`; shared validation and condition errors come from `storage.contract`. Retain causes for diagnosis. Explicit cleanup rejects on failure; resource syntax reports cleanup failures to preserve a primary error. Release read objects before closing the host. Supplied S3 clients remain yours to close. Shutdown does not delete stored content.
